en.purpose: To calculate the total sum for the SULF-FAST (Trimethoprim-Sulfamethoxazole Allergy Decision Rule) to estimate risk when considering sulfonamide antibiotic therapy in adults (≥18 years) with a reported trimethoprim–sulfamethoxazole (TMP-SMX) allergy.
en.use:
Use to assess the risk of true antimicrobial sulfonamide allergy in adult patients (≥18 years) with a reported  trimethoprim–sulfamethoxazole (TMP-SMX) allergy.
The rule is calculated by adding the points of the individual variables:
Five years or less since reaction: No - 0 points, Yes/unknown - 2 points
Anaphylaxis or angioedema OR Severe cutaneous adverse reaction: No - 0 points, Yes - 2 points
Treatment required for reaction: No - 0 points, Yes/unknown - 1 point
en.misuse: Not to be used for recording information related to other drug allergy prediction tools.
